text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Just before the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――
choice_data_list: Alright, let's call it a day...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Mm, got it. Still though— Haha, that's 
pretty tough, not gonna lie...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's amazing. To be able to pivot 
your track so much in such a short time 
after preparing for the Kikuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Well, since I've got your help on this, I 
can't just do a half-baked job."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold was going through her final 
adjustments with Bubble Gum Fellow, who 
had won the Tenno Sho (Autumn) during her 
Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to our desperate last-minute push 
leading up to today, she should be 
well-prepared to fight on race day. 
...However—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...Even from my perspective, Suzuka is 
overwhelming right now. She might just be 
one of the strongest of this era."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Probably so. I'd like to think I 
understand quite well.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Still, you're in such peak condition 
yourself, Senpai, that it's hard to 
believe you're in the Classic Class. 
There's no way you won't stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I'm rooting for you. After 
all, you showed me wonderful races in the 
Satsuki Sho and the Nippon Derby, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Haha. I'd certainly like to live up to 
those expectations."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, look forward to it. I intend to make 
it a race you won't be able to take your 
eyes off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Still, to think everyone went out of their 
way to come.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's a real pity we won't be running 
in the Kikuka Sho together, but I wanted 
to cheer you on~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...It is unfortunate that we won't get to 
see you run in the 'Kikuka Sho', but this 
choice feels very true to you as well."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please show Suzuka-san and the Senior 
Class runners the full power of the stride 
you've honed with me.

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Lady Stego, I pray for your good fortune 
in battle. And please, seize the glory of 
the Shield......!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure everything you've done for 
me pays off today. Watch closely, okay?
Zudegozaaan!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: WHYYYY THOUGH~~!!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
After we... after we made such a 
passionate vow, too~! That we'd settle 
things at the Kikuka Sho~!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, how do I put this... I'm truly sorry 
about that. The tide kind of turned on us, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I'm sure we'll have plenty more 
chances to run together. That's when we'll 
settle things."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"You said it, okay?! It's a promise! If 
you lie, I'll make you swallow ten million 
curses!!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Wahahaha. Now that sounds scary.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Still, was it really okay not going over 
to Suzuka?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, umm... Suzuka-san, well—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...She mentioned she 'wants to concentrate 
alone.'

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere didn't really allow for a 
conversation—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Stego-san. What could have happened to 
Suzuka-san?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Lately, she's constantly spacing out... 
And yet, during races, she's absolutely 
phenomenal—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It's as if... my soul is being drawn to 
something."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...You really are pretty sharp, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Don't worry about Suzuka. Just watch 
the race while wishing her good luck.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Surely that's the best thing for her too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Stego-san......—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I hope you have fun at today's race too, 
Fukukitaru.
choice_data_list:
There's no doubt about it—you're in peak 
condition right now.

As you are now, you're undoubtedly in 
perfect condition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I did everything I could. Stay Gold 
responded in kind. All that's left is to 
take the plunge.
choice_data_list: Have fun out there too, Stay Gold!
Have fun out there too, Stay Gold!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go have the time of my life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan A
text_block_list.text: "Suzukaaa! Run away with it again today!"

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Show us that incredible running again!! 
Do your best!!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Head in the clouds, huh.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(What is this...!? My "memories" are going 
wild—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(The countless feelings I received that 
day swirl together... and overflow—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――Shut up for a second.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...The one running in today's race is me. 
This race belongs to us."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: So... just sit back and watch, alright?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
We're... planning on having fun, after 
all.
